title: Document kind (ADR-089 §1)
description: A kind of document the pack recognises, as data. `identify` (worker/identify.py) scores each kind by its signals; no model, no code per kind. Patterns are Python regular expressions; a pattern may start with an inline flag such as (?i).

declaredAs.description: The values of the declared kind (what the user said it is) that agree with this kind.

signals.description: What the text says when it is this kind. A kind needs at least one of them to be detected.

jurisdictionHints.description: Jurisdiction signals: they add to the kind's weight and, when no jurisdiction is declared, name the jurisdiction.

excludes.description: A text that matches one is never this kind.

pattern.description: At least one capturing group; the first group that matched is the date, as written.

asOfFrom.description: The id of the date signal whose date is the `asOf` of the check.

ruleset.description: The ruleset that judges this kind; null while the kind is only KNOWN.

status.description: PROMOTED: a ruleset exists. KNOWN: recognised, no ruleset (the run says so). RETIRED: no longer detected.

expect.description: MATCH: identify detects this kind. NO_MATCH: it does not.

documentDate.description: The date identify must read (null: none, the blank form).
